description_en: Configures the detailed settings of a production studio, including parameters such as the name, transcoding configuration, and recording configuration
description_zh: 调用本接口对导播台进行详细配置，包括导播台的名称、转码配置、录制配置等参数信息
name: SetCasterConfig

parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, check the value of the CasterId parameter returned in the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, choose ApsaraVideo Live Console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio to view the ID.

The name of the production studio in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the ID of the production studio
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html接口创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the production studio
parameters.help_zh: 导播台名称
parameters.name: caster_name

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain.

Configure the domain name before you start the production studio. If this parameter is left empty, the domain name configuration of the production studio is cleared by default
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。

请您在导播台启动前完成域名配置。 若该参数为空，默认清除导播台域名配置。
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The transcoding configuration. 

The value must be a JSON string. The fields in the struct must be in camel case with the first letter capitalized. If this parameter is left empty, the transcoding configuration is cleared by default. If the transcoding template is empty, an error is reported when the production studio is started
parameters.help_zh:
转码配置。 

JSON格式字符串，结构体内部字段请按首字母大写，驼峰格式输入。 若该参数设置为空，默认清除转码配置， 当转码模板为空的时候，导播台启动时会报错
parameters.name: transcode_config

parameters.help_en:
The recording configuration. The value must be in JSON format. The configuration elements are as follows:

endpoint: the public https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html of the region where the Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket is located.
ossBucket: the name of the Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket.
videoFormat: the supported video file formats for export. Example: [{\"OssObjectPrefix\":\"record/{AppName}/{StreamName}/{StartTime}{EndTime}\",\"Format\":\"m3u8\",\"CycleDuration\":21600,\"SliceOssObjectPrefix\":\"record/{AppName}/{StreamName}/{UnixTimestamp}\"},{\"OssObjectPrefix\":\"record/{AppName}/{StreamName}/{StartTime}{EndTime}\",\"Format\":\"flv\",\"CycleDuration\":21600}].
interval: the time interval, in milliseconds.

If this parameter is left empty, the recording feature is disabled. If this parameter is set to empty, the recording configuration is cleared by default
parameters.help_zh:
录制配置信息。格式为JSON。配置元素信息如下：

endpoint：阿里云OSS Bucket地域对应的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html。
ossBucket：阿里云OSS Bucket名称。
videoFormat：支持导出的视频文件格式，例如：[{\"OssObjectPrefix\":\"record/{AppName}/{StreamName}/{StartTime}{EndTime}\",\"Format\":\"m3u8\",\"CycleDuration\":21600,\"SliceOssObjectPrefix\":\"record/{AppName}/{StreamName}/{UnixTimestamp}\"},{\"OssObjectPrefix\":\"record/{AppName}/{StreamName}/{StartTime}{EndTime}\",\"Format\":\"flv\",\"CycleDuration\":21600}]。
interval：时间间隔，单位为毫秒（ms）。

参数设置为空时表示不启用录制功能。 若该参数置为空，默认清除录制配置
parameters.name: record_config

parameters.help_en:
The stream delay. Unit: seconds.

0 (default): disables the stream delay.
Greater than 0: enables the stream delay.
Empty: clears the stream delay configuration by default.
The maximum stream delay is 300 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
延时播放。时间单位：秒。

0（默认值）：禁用延时。
大于0：启用延时。
空：默认清除延播配置。
最大可支持设置300秒
parameters.name: delay

parameters.help_en: The ID of the standby video material in the media asset library. If this parameter is set to empty, the standby configuration is cleared by default
parameters.help_zh: 备播视频，媒资库素材ID。若该参数置为空，默认清除备播配置
parameters.name: urgent_material_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the standby live stream
parameters.help_zh: 备播直播流URL
parameters.name: urgent_live_stream_url

parameters.help_en:
The custom ingest URL that corresponds to the bypass output URL of the production studio. 
If this parameter is left empty, the ingest URL that corresponds to the automatically generated output URL of Alibaba Cloud is used by default.
Currently, the SideOutputUrl parameter only supports RTMP stream ingest
parameters.help_zh:
用户自定义导播台旁路输出地址对应的推流地址。 
若该参数为空，则默认使用阿里云自动生成的输出地址对应的推流地址。
目前sideoutputUrl只支持rtmp协议推流
parameters.name: side_output_url

parameters.help_en:
The list of multi-channel relay ingest URLs. The URLs can be CDN ingest URLs of Alibaba Cloud or third-party vendors. A single production studio supports up to 20 RTMP relay ingest URLs.


Specify multiple URLs in the array format, such as ["rtmp://domain/app1/stream1","rtmp://domain/app2/stream2"]
parameters.help_zh:
多路转推流地址列表，可以是阿里云或第三方厂商的CDN推流地址，一个导播台最多支持添加20个RTMP转推地址。


多个地址用["rtmp://domain/app1/stream1","rtmp://domain/app2/stream2"]数组格式
parameters.name: side_output_url_list

parameters.help_en:
The custom callback URL. To receive callback notifications, enter an available receiving URL that supports the HTTP protocol. If this parameter is set to empty, the callback notifications for the production studio are canceled by default.
For more information about production studio callbacks, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213633.html
parameters.help_zh:
用户回调地址。若需要接收回调通知，请输入可用的接收地址，接受HTTP协议。 若该参数置为空，默认取消导播台回调通知。
导播台回调详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213633.html
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en:
The carousel effect flag. 

0: does not take effect.
1: takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
轮播生效标志。 

0：不生效。
1：生效
parameters.name: program_effect

parameters.help_en: The name of the carousel studio. This parameter can be configured when the carousel feature is used
parameters.help_zh: 轮播台名称，若使用轮播功能时可配置
parameters.name: program_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the channel. If the production studio channel was previously enabled (ChannelEnable=1), you must explicitly pass ChannelEnable=1 in each call to maintain the channel status. Otherwise, the InvalidCaster.ChannelDisableUnsupported error is returned.
         
0 (default): does not enable the channel.
1: enables the channel. 

By default, the channel is not enabled and cannot be disabled after it is enabled. When the channel is not enabled, resources are directly referenced by layouts. The channel must be enabled for the first time when the production studio is stopped. Existing layouts are deprecated. Resources must be set to the channel first. New layouts directly reference the channel. You can adjust the playback progress and status of the video source through the channel. In this mode, if the video source, PVW, and PGM areas reference the same resource, the corresponding screens remain synchronized
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用Channel。 若导播频道此前已启用（ChannelEnable=1），每次调用必须显式传入 ChannelEnable=1 以保持频道状态，否则将返回错误 InvalidCaster.ChannelDisableUnsupported。
         
0（默认）：不启用。
1：启用。 

默认不启用，且启用后不可取消；不启用时Resource直接被布局引用，首次开启Channel需要在导播台停止的状态下进行，之前已存在的布局将被废弃，Resource需要首先设置到Channel中，新增的布局直接引用Channel，通过Channel可调整视频源播放进度和播放状态，该模式下视频源、PVW、PGM三区域若引用同一Resource，则对应画面将保持同步
parameters.name: channel_enable

parameters.help_en:
The multi-view synchronization configuration, which synchronizes multiple video sources.
Multi-view synchronization has two modes:

mode: 0 (Streamer mode: multiple video sources are synchronized based on the specified mode.)

mode: 1 (Conference mode: there is no concept of a streamer video, and all video sources are synchronized with each other.)



Streamer mode: hostResourceId: the streamer video source in streamer mode.

Conference mode: the hostResourceId field is not provided. Only the resource IDs in the resourceIds field are provided
parameters.help_zh:
多视角同步配置，让多个视频源同步。
多视角同步分为两个模式：

mode: 0（主播模式，多个视频源根据指定的模式同步。）

mode: 1（会议模式，没有主播视频的概念，所有视频源相互同步。）



主播模式：hostResourceId：主播模式下的主播视频源

会议模式：没有hostRsoureId 字段，只提供需要提供的resourceIds 中的资源ids
parameters.name: sync_groups_config

parameters.help_en: The ID of the standby image material in the media asset library
parameters.help_zh: 备播媒资库图片素材ID
parameters.name: urgent_image_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the standby image material
parameters.help_zh: 备播图片素材URL
parameters.name: urgent_image_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic switchover to the standby source upon stream interruption.
true: enables the feature.
false: disables the feature
parameters.help_zh:
开启断流自动切换备播。
true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: auto_switch_urgent_on

parameters.help_en:
The automatic switchover to the standby source configuration.
eofThres: the time threshold for automatic switchover to the standby source after stream interruption, in seconds
parameters.help_zh:
自动切备播配置。
`eofThres`：表示断流时间后自动切备播，单位为秒
parameters.name: auto_switch_urgent_config

CasterId.description_en: The ID of the production studio. This parameter can be used as a request parameter for querying the stream URL of the production studio, starting the production studio, adding video resources to the production studio, adding layouts to the production studio, querying the layout list of the production studio, adding components to the production studio, and adding program lists to the production studio
CasterId.description_zh: 导播台ID。可作为查询导播台流地址、启动导播台、添加导播台视频资源、添加导播台布局、查询导播台布局列表、添加导播台组件和添加导播台节目单的请求参数
